opinions.text: Ct. App. Ky. [Certiorari granted, 406 U. S. 905.] Motion of Charles H. Keating, Jr., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of First Amendment Lawyers' Assn, for leave to file untimely brief as amicus curiae in support of petitioner denied. Motion of Joel Hirschhorn for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae in support of petitioner denied.
